value.title: Phase 1: lock + advice + sweep
value.summary: One coder, tasks in order, every assertion pinned to a backpressure row.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: Work top to bottom; stop-and-ask o-prime on anything outside the fence.

value.title: Serialise create/drop: a process-wide async lock (tokio::sync::Semaphore(N) or Mutex) around fs3_store::create_database / drop_database calls inside FreshDatabase; N from an env knob defaulting to 1; document why in the module doc
value.success: concurrency test green; red with the lock removed
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-testkit serialis: 1 passed (artifact://25); mutation removing permit: FAILED, observed more than 1 concurrent database mutations (artifact://27); guard restored at fresh_database.rs:42-48

value.title: Truthful advice: classify the connect error (refused vs closed/recovering — SQLSTATE 57P03 or an EOF after connect) and word the panic accordingly; drop the compose suggestion when a server is listening
value.receipt: cargo test -p fs3-testkit advice: 2 passed (artifact://36); refused port says No server and includes compose command; listening-close server says recovery/wait-and-retry and excludes compose command

value.title: Sweep matches minted names: parse both `fs3_test_<epoch>_<hex>` and `fs3_<label>_<epoch>_<hex>`; keep the age threshold; add a list-only mode that returns candidates without dropping
value.success: sweep test green for both shapes; red without
value.receipt: FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@127.0.0.1:5433/flowspace3_test cargo test -p fs3-testkit sweep: 2 passed (artifact://45); list-only reported both epoch-1 minted shapes, sweep dropped those two, fresh remained; prod-like names rejected

value.title: Real usage on the shared container: run the oversize suite at default parallelism; grep the postgres log for recovery lines in that window; record counts
value.receipt: Window start 2026-09-02T00:54:34Z; FS3_TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgres://flowspace3:flowspace3@127.0.0.1:5433/flowspace3_test cargo test -p fs3-daemon --test oversize: 12 passed in 13.81s (artifact://59); docker logs flowspace3-db since start: recovery signature count 0

value.title: Gate and PR: harness checks green; fix: commits via harness commit; PR into main with the mutation stated
With o-prime: sweep list mode against the prod server (read-only) naming the orphans; after GO, the drop; before/after counts into the receipt

tk-0101.assertion: at most N in flight observed; >1 with the lock removed (mutation in PR)

tk-0102.assertion: recovery wording and no-server wording each asserted; no compose text when listening

tk-0103.assertion: two old minted names swept, one fresh kept, both shapes

tk-0104.assertion: test exit 0 and log grep count 0, with the time window stated

tk-0105.assertion: harness checks green; CI green on the PR head
